Zara

Overview

Zara is a widowed merchant on Suslanger whose business draws Kir and Kel into contraband, blackmail and a missing caravan. Her later requests mix commerce with personal affection: she wants Kehel’s standing damaged to favour a scholar she loves. Her claims and suspicions form leads to investigate, rather than automatic proof against the people she names. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

Zara’s affairs

The merchant Zara is another of Kel’s Suslanger contacts. Her side of the story involves a blackmailer, a threatened caravan and contraband that must be recovered before the authorities inspect it. The conversations distinguish successful recovery from arriving too late; the account of the caravan therefore depends on the outcome of that errand. Later, Zara’s interest in a scholar draws Kir into a scheme against Kehel. These dealings develop alongside the search for a Joon, rather than forming a single inevitable sequence of victories. [2, 6, 7, 3, 4, 8, 5, 9]
